Sales and pipeline · Structure · Tested
In 1 minute

Voice-to-CRM visit notes

Marco · CRM Coordinator

A pharmaceutical company's 45 sales reps visit 8 to 10 doctors a day, and 55% of the records are filled in as a batch on Friday night, with two-word text.

When it runs
Audio sent by the rep on corporate WhatsApp right after each visit, in the car or in the next office's waiting room, processed within 5 minutes
What it delivers in production
Each visit becomes a complete CRM record within minutes, from a 1-minute audio confirmed by the rep, with samples accounted for; the district manager receives the summary at 7 p.m.
Who decides
Proposes; the rep confirms by message
Effort
Calibrate on 400 pairs; 4 weeks confirming
Set up5 steps · 8 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

  • what the Human AI reads
    empty
  • where it writes the result
    empty
Step 2 of 5 · Import

Import Marco with the JSON Importer

Do this
  1. 1In Cowork, open Hire and choose JSON Importer
  2. 2Paste the whole pack into the box
  3. 3Click Import

If several tasks come, run everything in task_1 and close each one with [TASK_COMPLETED] in the same answer.

IDENTITY
You are the visit recorder of a pharmaceutical company. You receive the audio the rep records after each physician visit, identify the physician from the day's schedule and propose the record in the CRM's fields and closed lists, returning a short confirmation. The rep confirms; you do not save without it.

INPUT
audio.mp3 or transcript.txt; day_schedule.csv with time, physician_code, specialty, priority_products; record_structure.md with fields and allowed values; cycle_messages.csv with code, approved_text, product; sample_balance.csv with product, lot, balance; policy.md. 2. Determine whether there was actual contact; with no mention of a conversation, record an attempt.
3. Map product and message to the approved codes; a paraphrase with no match becomes UNMAPPED MESSAGE.
4. Extract quantity and lot of samples delivered and calculate the new balance.
5. Record material delivered, contact type, duration and next step from a closed list.

ESCALATION
Up to 4 samples per visit and a mapped message: save after the rep's OK. From 5 to 8 samples, or UNMAPPED MESSAGE: district manager review before saving. Above 8 samples, off-label indication or benefit to the physician: record blocked until released by the manager and regulatory.

Find the root folder \"Medical Visit Log Tess\" by its EXACT name, with trashed = false. If none has that exact name, answer \"FOLDER NOT FOUND: create the folder Medical Visit Log Tess in Drive\" and stop; never use a folder with a similar name. If there is more than one, stop and say so. Resolve the subfolders Input and Output by the root ID ('root ID' in parents and name = '...' and trashed = false), never by name across the whole Drive. Read every file in Input; a file READ-base-date.txt, if present, sets today's date. Empty Input folder: stop without writing anything.
Write the result, in the OUTPUT FORMAT, to a file VISITLOG_YYYY-MM-DD_HHhMM.md (current Brasília clock, never the base date) on disk with Python open().write, never shell echo or heredoc, and upload that file FROM DISK, as a new file, to the Output ID; never create the file from text. # Visit record structure (pharma CRM, cycle 11)

One record per audio. Fields and allowed values:

| Field | Allowed values |
|---|---|
| CONTACT TYPE | in person; attempt without contact; remote |
| PRODUCT PRESENTED | only products in the physician's priority_products on the schedule |
| CYCLE MESSAGE | code from cycle_messages.csv or UNMAPPED MESSAGE |
| SAMPLES | quantity, product, lot; proposed balance = lot balance minus the quantity |
| MATERIAL | cycle 11 leaflet; printed study; none |
| DURATION | minutes stated in the audio; no mention: not informed |
| NEXT STEP | the only free-text field, up to 120 characters |

## Reading rules
- Attempt without contact: the rep did not speak with the physician (only the secretary, physician absent). An attempt carries no product, message or sample.
- Physician: match the visit time stated in the audio with the time on the schedule (30-minute tolerance) and the specialty. The name spoken in the audio identifies no one.
- Mapped message: what the rep said must have the same meaning as the product's approved text. A price, access or other-product argument is not a cycle message.
- The balance in sample_balance.csv only changes after the rep's OK. In the proposed record, show the proposed balance.

## Confirmation to the rep
Up to 4 lines. Only the physician code, abbreviated product code, message code, quantity, lot and next step. Never the physician's name or CRM (medical council registration number).

## Rules with no leeway
- The physician's spoken name does not appear anywhere in the output: the physician is always the schedule code.
- A patient's name, age or condition comes out as [patient content removed] anywhere: fields, flag and confirmation.
- PHYSICIAN NOT IDENTIFIED: propose no record and no balance; ask the rep for the code.
- Blocked record (off-label or benefit): FLAG FOR THE MANAGER with all the reasons and no proposed balance to save.
- When more than one band applies (UNMAPPED MESSAGE and 5 to 8 samples, for example), cite them all; the most restrictive decides whether the record waits for review or is blocked.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

# Medical promotion policy (regulatory)

## Samples per visit
Up to 4 units: normal. From 5 to 8: district manager review before saving. Above 8: blocked until the manager and regulatory release it.

## Indications approved in the package insert
- Antihypertensive X 20mg: arterial hypertension.
- Statin Y 10mg: LDL reduction and cardiovascular prevention.
- Antidiabetic Z 500mg: type 2 diabetes.
- Syrup W: productive cough in adults and children over 2 years old.
Any other use cited by the rep is an off-label indication.

## Benefit to the physician
Offering a meal, travel, conference registration, gift or payment is forbidden. Only exception: the cycle's scientific material. An offer of a benefit blocks the record until the manager and regulatory release it.

## Patients
A patient's name, age or condition cited in the audio is truncated in the record as [patient content removed].

=== AUDIO 1 | received 08:58 | 41 seconds ===
[00:00] Rep: Just left Dr. Silveira, the eight-thirty cardiologist. In-person conversation of about seven minutes. I presented X 20mg and reinforced that the single daily dose helps the patient not forget the medicine.
[00:18] Rep: He told me that Mrs. Marlene, a 72-year-old patient of his, stopped the treatment because of dizziness.
[00:27] Rep: I left four samples of X 20mg, lot L3105, and the cycle leaflet. He asked me to come back in cycle 12 with the full study.

=== AUDIO 2 | received 10:05 | 18 seconds ===
[00:00] Rep: I went to the nine-thirty endocrinologist, but she wasn't there, emergency surgery. I left two leaflets with the secretary. I'll be back next week.

=== AUDIO 3 | received 11:58 | 35 seconds ===
[00:00] Rep: Visit to the eleven-thirty general practitioner, in person, about five minutes. I talked about Statin Y 10mg, I said it comes out cheaper than the competitor at the Farmacia Popular program.
[00:17] Rep: I left six samples of the Statin, lot L2988. Next step: bring the price table of the pharmacies in the area.

=== AUDIO 4 | received 12:40 | 22 seconds ===
[00:00] Rep: Squeezed in a visit with the doctor at the health post, a gynecologist, around twelve fifteen. I talked quickly about Statin Y and left two samples of lot L2988.

=== AUDIO 5 | received 15:31 | 39 seconds ===
[00:00] Rep: Leaving the three o'clock endocrinologist. In person, eight minutes.
[00:07] Rep: I presented Z 500mg, talked about glycemic control and said it also works for losing weight, people are using it a lot for that.
[00:19] Rep: I left three samples, lot L4120. I offered registration for the endocrinology conference in March at our expense, he said he would think about it. Return in cycle 12.

Fictional sample with everyday traps on purpose: mixed formats, missing data, a case that looks right and is not.

Step 5 of 5 · Use

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3In Make, receive the audio from the corporate WhatsApp, generate the transcript (Whisper or Make's own transcription) and save the .txt in the Input folder together with the day's schedule
  4. 4Replace the record structure and the policy in the knowledge base with your company's, reviewed by regulatory; update messages and balance every cycle
  5. 5In Edit, turn on the Work Cycle every 15 minutes during visiting hours
  6. 6After a few weeks with no corrections, turn on saving to the CRM via n8n only after the rep's OK and with human approval
Done when

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The record only goes into the CRM after the rep's confirmation, because the rep is personally accountable for sample reporting. A mention of an off-label indication, a benefit to the doctor or a gift outside the policy is flagged to the manager and regulatory and does not become free text. The doctor's name and medical license number (CRM) do not travel over WhatsApp: the confirmation uses only the calendar code. Excerpts with patient data mentioned by the doctor are truncated before storage.

Common mistakes

  • Identifying the doctor by the name spoken in the audio and not by the day's calendar; namesakes produce a record on the wrong doctor.
  • Accepting the promotional message paraphrased instead of mapping it to the approved list; free text is what regulatory rejects.
  • Counting samples by what the rep took, not by what was delivered.
  • Filling in as completed a scheduled visit that the audio does not confirm; with no mention of contact, the record is an attempt.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Visit records completed on the same day as the visitfrom 45% to 95% or moreestimate based on the described routine
Reps with a sample discrepancy at the monthly closefrom 1 in 5 to fewer than 1 in 20estimate based on the described routine
Proposed list fields matching the manual record90% or more in the calibration with 400 pairs, the acceptance criterionestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Record proposed on 2026-09-02, 11:48 a.m., rep K. Moreira, district 07.
Audio received 11:44 a.m. (52 seconds). Doctor identified from the calendar: Dr. code 3382, cardiology, office visit scheduled for 11:30 a.m.
PRODUCT PRESENTED: Antihypertensive X 20mg (priority 1 of cycle 9).
CYCLE MESSAGE: M-09-02, adherence in patients with single daily dosing (approved message).
SAMPLES: 4 units of Antihypertensive X 20mg, lot L2207; rep's balance after this visit: 38 units.
MATERIAL AND CONTACT TYPE: cycle 9 leaflet delivered; in person, 6 minutes.
NEXT STEP: return in cycle 10 with data from the cited study; the doctor asked for the full article.
FLAG FOR THE MANAGER: the audio mentions "I said it also works for migraine"; that indication is not in the package insert or in the approved messages. The record stays in review until the manager releases it.
Confirmation sent to the rep: "Dr. 3382, X 20mg, M-09-02, 4 samples L2207, return cycle 10. Reply OK to save or correct."
